newsitem.title: USA: New Marriott president to focus on growth.
newsitem.headline: New Marriott president to focus on growth.

text.p: The new president and chief operating officer of Marriott International Inc said Thursday he planned to concentrate on looking for opportunities for the company to grow, including acquisitions.

"I would say (that) would be the greater focus: on how we can continue to find additional growth opportunities," said William Shaw in a conference call. "Some can be new brands and others can be acquisitions that we would look at."
Shaw, who is to assume the two positions March 31, did not elaborate.
Shaw, who has been working for the company for 22 years, was executive vice president of the Marriott service group before accepting the promotion.
The company announced the appointment earlier in the day.
A Marriott spokesman said Shaw will be replacing J.W. Marriott, who has relinquished the posts to concentrate on his responsibilities as chairman and chief executive officer of the company.
Earlier Thursday, the company announced plans to add 120,000 hotel rooms across its lodging brands over the next five years.
But Shaw and Marriott, who also participated in the conference call, declined to comment on those plans.
